verdict.rationale: Lium documents several first-party ways to rent a GPU on demand: CLI `lium up --gpu H100`, the API `POST /executors/rent-by-spec`, a create-pod flow with Jupyter, and an SDK that runs a function on a rented node. Code can then run via `lium exec`, root and Docker-in-Docker, so the provisioning-to-running path is clearly covered. The OpenAPI probe 404s only hit docs.lium.io paths; the spec is documented at lium.io/api/openapi.json, so it is not a contradiction. missing for 10: evidence of time-to-running (the 'within minutes' claim), independent or hands-on corroboration of the provisioning flow.
